decisions.statement: A `split` parts one stretch into two stretches at the time said.
`split` reads `--at` as the time the stretch is parted at.
A time falling outside the stretch parted is refused.
Both halves a `split` makes have the relationships of the stretch parted.
A stretch is addressed by the id that stretch has.
A stretch is addressed by a time that stretch covers.
A stretch is addressed by being the open stretch.
A stretch is addressed by being the stretch that ended last.
No act here needs an id to address a stretch.
A wall time this command takes or says is a US Mountain time.
`--relationship` names a relationship by its id or by its title.
A title no relationship has is refused rather than written.
A title more than one relationship has is refused.
A relationship a title tags is kept beside one `--relationship` names.
An alias more than one relationship has tags neither and refuses nothing.
An act that sets a title reads that title for aliases.
A write here is judged as `check` judges.

definition: the command parting one stretch into two at a time said
